meaning: Rights register for everything the app ships, including native launcher and splash art (GM-025). rights_status 'reviewed' means a person recorded author, license or permission, attribution and redistribution terms and a review date. Nothing below is reviewed except where stated. Bundling an asset is not proof of redistribution rights; unreviewed assets block release (scripts/release_metadata.py --release).
